groups.name: Classical antiquity
groups.desc: A classical and humanist apparatus through which prosodists route their discussions.

groups.name: Medieval writing
groups.desc: Centred on Chaucer, with Middle English, Latin and French points of comparison.

groups.name: Early modern English poetry
groups.desc: An early modern repertoire anchored by Shakespeare, Spenser, Jonson, Marlowe, Donne and Sidney.

groups.name: Eighteenth-century criticism
groups.desc: An eighteenth-century critical-pedagogical lane around Pope, Dryden, Johnson and Swift.

groups.name: Romantic and Victorian poetry
groups.desc: A large Anglophone neighbourhood centred on nineteenth-century exemplars.

groups.name: Modern and transatlantic field
groups.desc: The transatlantic and early-modernist penumbra of the nineteenth-century neighbourhood.

groups.name: Continental comparison
groups.desc: French and German comparanda treated as a parallel tradition of verse theory.
